title: Sophisticated Drawing Room & Lounge
tagline: Italian marble backdrop, fluted wall molding, and stepped multi-tier cove ceiling
description: Commissioned to create an opulent yet calm drawing room for executive hosting. Features full-height bookmatched Italian marble media wall, delicate gold metal wall moldings, crystal chandeliers, acoustic drapery, and custom low-profile seating.

details.Materials: Italian Statuario Marble, Brushed Brass Accents, Natural Veneer, Warm 3000K LED Cove
